**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

I am going to Lichfield from Monday to Saturday of next week - to talk and look over letters of [our noble martyr](../persons.html#1155) with the [Selwyns](../persons.html#1295). I believe I am to manage the putting his [life](../books.html#102) together but it will be more editing than writing. I seem to have thought of nothing but the wonderful symbolism of the work of those unconscious savages.[^1]
Your affectionate

C M Yonge

[^1]: CMY refers to the murder of the Rt.

Rev.

John Coleridge Patteson in the Santa Cruz Islands.

It was reported that Patteson’s body had received five wounds, as Christ\'s had.
